def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")

action.old_text:
# Compute sum of log probabilities along the horizon axis
    sum_with = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
    sum_call = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
    sum_no = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)

    # Margin: reduction in negative log-likelihood when using the result
    margin = sum_with - sum_no  # positive if with-result is better

    # Keep if: reduction > threshold AND with-result is better than call-only
    keep = (margin > tau_filter) & (sum_with > sum_call)

    return keep, margin
